models: Read and publish the catalog of AI models.
models diff: Compare a proposed model catalog with the current one.
models get: Show the model catalog, or one model in it.
models level-proposal: Propose level changes from the model catalog.
models lookup: Show the catalog entry for one launch model name.
models publish: Publish a new model catalog revision.
models restore: Restore the model catalog from an older revision.
models validate: Check one proposed model record without saving it.
